data.body:
PROBE TICKET — disposable, safe for a human to close or delete.

Created 2026-08-27 solely to exercise the LIVE rebar MCP server. It carries no production work.

It could NOT be closed by the probe run: the plan-review close gate refuses it

    plan-review close gate: unsigned: no certified plan-review attestation.
    Run rebar review-plan c67b-ece5-707e-460e separately, then retry close.

and the prescribed remedy is itself broken on that server — review_plan with its default
attested source fails with "cannot resolve ref 'origin/main' to a commit in '.'" because the
container repo root has no git metadata. That defect is filed as
fatherly-incoherent-mare (1eb6-65f2-5a4e-4c7b).

Per the operating rules the probe run did not use --force, so this ticket is deliberately left
in_progress. Once fatherly-incoherent-mare is fixed, this can be closed with
close_class=obsolete; it is also fine to close it administratively at any time.
